items.justification: Per-invocation native effects handle (cancel flag, stack depth, profiling clock); opaque, the Lean model is an arbitrary native state threaded by the checker.
Shell-only constructor of the native services; extracted code receives them and never constructs them.
Shell-only profiling switch applied by the embedding shell before an invocation.
Shell-only test override of the stack segment size.
Relaxed load of the shared cancellation flag; modeled as a monotone boolean observation schedule.
Reads the remaining native stack (stacker); modeled as an arbitrary boolean observation schedule.
Guarded-frame depth increment on the opaque services state.
Guarded-frame depth saturating decrement on the opaque services state.
Guarded-frame depth reset on the opaque services state.
Runs the closure on a fresh native stack segment (stacker::grow); modeled as plain application.
Reads the profiling clock; modeled as an arbitrary mark with no effect on checking.
Writes a profiling line to stderr; modeled as a no-op.
SHA-256 of the concatenated parts through the sha2 crate; modeled by the FIPS 180-4 Lean model.

JSON Schema of the fixed-width lowercase hex IEEE bits of the exact wire codec (schemars); wire-format tooling called only by the exact_wire_codec integration test (schema_for!), no extracted item uses it.

Anonymous const block of #[derive(schemars::JsonSchema)] on the scalar wire enum; contains only the derived JSON Schema impl, reached only through the ScalarValue schema, wire-format tooling that no extracted item uses.

Anonymous const block of #[derive(schemars::JsonSchema)] on the tensor storage wire enum; contains only the derived JSON Schema impl, reached only through the TensorStorage schema, wire-format tooling that no extracted item uses.
JSON Schema of the exact scalar wire form (schemars); wire-format tooling called only by the exact_wire_codec integration test (schema_for!), no extracted item uses it.
JSON Schema of the exact tensor storage wire form (schemars); wire-format tooling called only by the exact_wire_codec integration test (schema_for!), no extracted item uses it.
Handle on the process-global capacity-scope identity sequence; opaque, modeled as an opaque supply state.
Checked relaxed increment of a process-global AtomicU64; modeled as the next element of a strictly increasing sequence.
Derived Debug of the opaque native supply handle; no extracted item formats it.
Shell-only acquisition of the native supply; extracted code receives the supply from its caller.
Field-less handle naming this thread's lowering state; opaque, the Lean model threads the flags as explicit state.
std::panic::resume_unwind of a payload; modeled as failure of the enclosing native entry.
Runs body between enter and exit, also on native unwind (drop guard); modeled as enter; body; exit.
stacker::maybe_grow around the closure; modeled as plain application.
Reads the thread-local speculation flag u.
Writes the thread-local speculation flag u.
Writes the thread-local quiet-output flag o.
Runs the native panic hook for an explicit raise (catch_unwind); modeled as one appended hook observation.
catch_unwind on a grown stack with quiet output; modeled as o := true; f; o := false.
Relaxed fetch_add on the process-global host inference variable supply; modeled as an allocation schedule.
Saturating increment of the thread-local summary-probe counter.
Reads the thread-local summary-probe counter.
Resets the thread-local summary-probe counter.
Next id of the thread-local preflight frame supply; modeled as an allocation schedule.
Reads the environment and clock for detailed profiling; modeled as an arbitrary mark.
Writes a profiling line to stderr; modeled as a no-op.
Starts a per-declaration profiling clock; modeled as an arbitrary mark.
Writes a per-declaration profiling line to stderr; modeled as a no-op.
Writes one internal diagnostic line to stderr; modeled as a no-op.
Pushes a clock reading onto the thread-local profile marks; used only by the profiling primitives.
Reads and restarts a thread-local profiling clock; used only by the profiling primitives.
Per-thread Cell flags and counters that LoweringRuntime names; only primitives touch it.
thread_local! instance of NativeLoweringState.
thread_local! profiling clocks.
Process-global AtomicU32 host inference variable supply.
LazyLock that installs the process panic hook once.
Installs the native panic hook (process-global side effect).
Native observability adapter: acquires this thread's LoweringRuntime to read the summary-probe counter (chelis#1829).
Native observability adapter: acquires this thread's LoweringRuntime to reset the summary-probe counter.
Shell-only acquisition of this thread's LoweringRuntime handle by native adapters.
